title: Legal aid and access to justice
notes: Official legal aid contact information and regional offices. Ask the commission about eligibility, legal representation and consultation.

title: Human rights and administrative complaints
notes: Official complaint form for human rights and administrative justice concerns. Confirm eligibility and the complaint process directly.

title: Discrimination reporting
organisation: CHRAJ Stigma and Discrimination Reporting System
notes: Official reporting platform for stigma and discrimination. Read the service's privacy information before submitting personal details.

title: Digital security assistance
notes: Digital security assistance for civil society. Eligibility checks apply; use the official contact instructions. This is not a general emergency service.

title: Support for human rights defenders at risk
notes: Emergency contact and secure assistance options for human rights defenders at immediate risk. Use the official page for current contact details and eligibility.

title: Refugee and asylum information
notes: Country-specific information for refugees, asylum seekers and stateless people. Select your country for available services; this website is an information portal.

title: Journalist assistance
notes: Assistance information for journalists and media facing risks linked to their work. Contact the organisation to check eligibility and current support.

title: Digital safety for journalists
organisation: Reporters Without Borders Digital Security Helpdesk
notes: Digital security learning resources for journalists. This is an information resource; it does not replace immediate incident response.

title: Telecommunications consumer complaints
notes: Official complaints portal for telecommunications consumers. Review the complaint requirements and privacy notice before submitting details.

title: Mental health information
notes: Public mental health information and resources. This is not a counselling service or crisis helpline; contact a qualified local service for individual care.
